decision_basis: XLSX row 2138, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2139 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00016-V002 / 473bb53b52af5337 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.

test_case.test_name: Stable-target separate-phase HGX NVQual Test #36 sequential SSD fio
test_case.purpose: Measure approved sequential read and write performance separately on the exact disposable SSD/volume while proving error-free completion, device/filesystem health, protected-storage safety and host stability without hang or reboot.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #36 or exact sequential fio job and compatible fio version
Signed disposable target serial/WWN/namespace and complete storage-stack identity
Explicit data-loss authorization and protected/shared/unknown storage exclusion proof
Approved separate read/write block size, depth, workers, size, duration, direct-I/O/cache, preconditioning and repetition profile
Signed per-direction performance/latency/error/health/thermal limits plus abort/isolation/re-provision recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration and explicit data-loss approval are signed. Re-resolve stable target identity and the full storage stack immediately before launch; inhibit on protected, shared, mounted production, unknown or changed mappings. Preserve logs and SMART/NVMe baseline. Run only the pinned separate Test #36 sequential read and write phases for the formal duration, retain complete machine-readable outputs and health, and stop on first anomaly. Do not choose, repair, format or retry.
test_case.expected_result: The exact authorized disposable target completes every signed sequential read and write phase with direction-specific BW/IOPS/latency/error/health thresholds met, no cache/preconditioning ambiguity, no unintended device/data touched, acceptable temperature/capacity/endurance, and no hang or reboot.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without stable target/data-loss authorization, exact separate phases and signed per-direction thresholds. PASS requires every complete accepted phase plus health evidence. FAIL on wrong/changed target, protected-storage exposure, incomplete phase, threshold miss, I/O/media/filesystem fault, thermal/capacity/endurance breach, hang/reboot or failed recovery. Missing inputs are BLOCKED; combined summaries or cached results cannot substitute.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until disposable identity, data-loss approval, protected-storage exclusions, separate job phases, thresholds and recovery are signed.
Revalidate stable hardware and full storage-stack identity immediately before each destructive phase.
Preserve baseline logs/health and run in a maintenance window with sufficient capacity, cooling and console recovery.
Stop without repair, reformat, phase repetition or automatic retry on first mismatch or fault.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, signed target manifest and explicit data-loss authorization
Immediate prelaunch serial/WWN/namespace/storage-stack map and protected-target exclusion proof
Pinned Test #36/fio configuration hash, separate phase accounting and direction-specific threshold contract
Complete raw sequential read and write BW/IOPS/latency/error/runtime outputs with cache/direct-I/O/preconditioning state
Pre/during/post SMART/NVMe health, media counters, temperature, filesystem/capacity, kernel/BMC/SEL evidence
Abort/isolation/re-provision or clean final state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On identity mismatch, protected-storage exposure, I/O/media/filesystem fault, thermal/capacity/endurance limit or evidence gap, terminate the active phase, preserve first-fault artifacts and isolate the target. Do not repair, format or rerun either direction automatically; follow signed re-provision recovery and quarantine uncertain storage.
